title: Brand-first marketing website
objective: Measure whether the branding-website craftbook locks a visual language before build, writes focused copy, and ships a responsive one-page marketing site.
prompt: In the `Branding Website Eval` project, build `index.html` for Lumina Ledger, a calm bookkeeping service for independent design studios. The page must include a hero, three value propositions, a pricing/fit section, a primary CTA to book a cleanup call, and a footer. Lock a visual language first with exact hex colors and concise brand rules, then build the final self-contained HTML with inline CSS and no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the branding-website craftbook. The deliverable is workspace/index.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a brand-led one-page marketing site for Lumina Ledger with locked palette, focused copy, responsive HTML/CSS, CTA, and footer.

success.summary: workspace/index.html is a complete branded marketing site with substantial CSS, brand/copy sections, and explicit palette evidence.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
